summary: Keep Live Oak as an active 200 MW Texas wind project and correct its infrastructure-fund entry year from 2021 to 2019. Regulatory and issuer evidence shows John Laing acquired a 75% sponsor block while ENGIE retained 25% and remained operator. The 75% block entered JLIL's existing portfolio in 2021; Equitix directly confirmed in April 2026 that JLIL remained 50:50 owned by Equitix and John Laing Group, now KKR-owned. Record those manager-level interests without inferring direct 37.5% project stakes. The exact post-March-2026 Equitix legal vehicle remains undisclosed but does not block manager-level ownership reconciliation.
